reconcile.note: Gill treats Nachon and Chidon as two names for the very same threshing floor where Uzzah reached for the ark and was struck down.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible ("Where did God kill Uzzah?", skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/uzza.html) (2013).

sides.snippet: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah put forth [his hand] to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen stumbled.
sides.verseText: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah put forth [his hand] to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen stumbled.

sides.snippet: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
sides.verseText: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
